P7646.corridor_notes: 亳州-淮南段 of the 文23-安庆天然气管道项目, ~210.8km, DN1016mm. Per PipeChina's Dec-2024 EIA notice, this segment does NOT get its own new pipe: '路由与川气东送二线天然气管道工程皖西支干线（预计2026年建成投产）高度重合，为避免重复建设，考虑此段路由依托皖西支干线。本项目对皖西支干线的阜阳分输清管站进行改扩建' (the route is highly coincident with the 皖西支干线/Anhui West branch of the separate 川气东送二线 project, expected online 2026; to avoid duplicate construction, this segment relies on/reuses the Anhui West branch's corridor; this project's own scope here is limited to renovating/expanding the Fuyang Distribution & Pigging Station — 阜阳分输清管站 — on that branch line). This is confirmed by two other PipeChina EIA notices for 川气东送二线天然气管道工程鄂豫赣皖浙闽段项目: the Oct-2024 notice for the main trunk + several liaison lines (not this branch), and a May-2025 pre-approval notice specifically for '(皖西支干线、皖赣支干线)' (Anhui-West branch + Anhui-Jiangxi branch) confirming 皖西支干线 as a real, separately-EIA'd PipeChina project crossing Hubei/Henan/Anhui/Zhejiang/Fujian as part of the broader 川气东送二线 corridor. GEM's own P7613 ('Huainan-Bozhou Branch Line', 川气东送二线, 208.4km, Anhui-Anhui) is almost certainly this same 皖西支干线, run in the reverse direction (Huainan→Bozhou vs. this row's Bozhou→Huainan) — see duplicate/flag note below. Neither the exact route of 皖西支干线 nor the Fuyang station's precise coordinates were locatable in available sources; 阜阳市 (Fuyang, Anhui) sits roughly midway on the Bozhou-Huainan line and is the most likely intermediate waypoint.
P7646.researcher_notes: Matches the existing GEM ResearcherNotes on this row almost verbatim (both trace to the same PipeChina EIA notice), so treat this as strong corroboration of an already-correct note rather than a new finding. FLAG (not set as duplicate_of, per instructions): this segment's route is explicitly stated to physically reuse the 川气东送二线 皖西支干线 corridor rather than laying new pipe — i.e., for GIS/route-drawing purposes, P7646's candidate geometry should likely BE (or very closely follow) P7613's geometry once that is drawn/sourced, just traversed in the opposite direction. Recommend the human reviewer check whether P7613 already has (or will get) a routes-repo geometry before independently drawing P7646, to avoid two near-identical but not-quite-matching traces for what is functionally one physical corridor. Endpoints given here are the same city-level approximations as P7645 (Bozhou) and P7647 (Huainan) start, for consistency across the three child segments.
P7646.blockers: No source gives station-level coordinates for either Bozhou South or Huainan liaison compressor stations, or for the Fuyang distribution/pigging station being renovated; all use city-level fallbacks. A human GIS pass against the underlying EIA report PDF (not opened — see P7644/P7645 notes) or the 川气东送二线 皖西支干线 EIA report would likely yield exact station coordinates and could also supply ready-made route geometry given the explicit corridor-reuse relationship to P7613.
